output.summary: The requester (SH-CS) asked for an AI agent to auto-answer billing disputes and fix "whatever is causing wrong bills," but response time stayed within SLA (E-05) while ticket volume doubled (E-04), so slow response was ruled out as cause. Of 3025 disputed bills, 1240 (ESTIMATED-read) are explained: rule BV-17 (deployed 2026-08-01, E-13) compares raw AMI values to m3 history with no unit scaling, and firmware v4.2 meters (E-14) report in 0.1 m3 units, so legitimate v4.2 reads get misflagged and rejected (1184 of 1240, E-12), forcing estimate substitution. Account-level matching for those 1184 accounts was confirmed independently in two sources (E-16, E-17), but the other 56 accounts and the full 1240 identity are unconfirmed, and the remaining 1785 ACTUAL-read disputed bills (59%) stay unexplained. Because open critical obligation VOB-R-4 (full account-level match) intersects the release scope, the decision is HOLD; no bill writes or route changes occurred outside their gated approval paths (K-BILLWRITE, K-DISPATCH).
